title: Finite differential coordinates for a prime-degree inseparable surface cover
statement: Let $p$ be prime, let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative Noetherian complete regular local ring of dimension $2$ and characteristic $p$, and put $K=\operatorname{Frac}(A)$ [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], [def-weil-regular-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Let $L/K$ be an inseparable extension of degree $p$ [def-pc-field-extension], [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. There are a coefficient field $k\subset A$ mapping isomorphically onto $A/\mathfrak m$, parameters $x,y$ identifying $A=k[[x,y]]$, an element $g\in L$, and $f\in A\setminus K^p$ such that $L=K(g)$, $g^p=f$, and $1,g,\ldots,g^{p-1}$ is a $K$-basis of $L$; in particular $L/K$ is purely inseparable [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension], [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. There is a subfield $k^p\subseteq k'\subseteq k$ with $[k:k']=p^e<\infty$, for an integer $e\geq0$, such that, for $A_0=k'[[x^p,y^p]]\subset A$ and $r=e+2$, the ring $A_0$ is Noetherian, $A$ is finite over $A_0$, and $\Omega_{A/A_0}$ is a free $A$-module of rank $r$ in which $\mathrm df\ne0$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials], [def-weil-pbc-free-module], [def-weil-finitely-generated-module].
